about: What changed on the site, newest first. Shown under the version number (top left). Add an entry for every change people can see and every fix, in the same commit, with the date it went live. kind: new | improved | fixed. The second number of the version goes up with each release; the first with a redesign.

changes.text: Text in the Reader (T): the text of the pages beside them, René Zandbergen's reference transliteration RF1b. Point at a word on the page to see what it reads; click it to see it cut from the photograph, with every other place in the book it appears.

Find, under the title of the text: a search of the whole book as you type, in Eva or with the glyph keys. Words that begin with what you type count (the exact word first; whole word and contains are a click away), each with its count; the word picked opens on its places. It stays until you clear it, and the address keeps it.
The text is shown as glyphs or in Eva, chosen from a dropdown. FSG and Currier are no longer offered.

The text's ? says in a few lines how to use it and where the text, the word positions and the photographs come from; Sources at the foot opens the same. The keyboard list under the ? at the top right keeps only the keys that matter.
“How the transcribers read it” and notes on words are gone from the word panel.

Text tab, Pages: a chip of its own beside Reading and Spaces, no longer inside More options; the set chosen can be edited or deleted from the same menu. New page set is one dialog instead of two prompts. Write pages and ranges (75r-84v, 1r) and see them read back as you type, with the count and anything that is not a page; or add a range from two menus, or a whole section, quire, scribe or language.

Text tab: More options ran off the right of narrower windows and pushed the whole view sideways; it, the ?, the i and Export stayed open until clicked again. They stay inside the window, and a click elsewhere or Esc closes them.
Text tab: clicking a page in the strip said “No results on …” when that page's results were further down than the list had got (past the first 150). The list now opens out to that page.
Text tab, Reading: any transcriber: a word written twice in one line was counted and marked once. Both count now.
Text tab: when nothing matched, an empty strip and empty filters were still drawn.
Text tab: opening #text alone wrote a broken address (#text/…/#text).
Text tab: section names in the strip overlapped on a phone, being measured before the strip was laid out.
Text tab: pointing at the strip while a search was still running threw an error.
The Text button in the Reader's bar has an icon, like Bookmark and Grid beside it.

On the round diagrams, a word's band of the ring now reaches the tops and tails of its own glyphs: 2,180 words on 25 pages, the zodiac and f57v most. An audit of every word's outline against the ink (docs/text/shapes_audit.md) found the bands a third too thin.
f89v2 no longer shows the book's page edges and a strip of the page beneath it.
Every page you go to turns a leaf, including from Go to, the strip and an unfolded foldout, and the book stays in the same place and size as you turn.
A folded foldout is one leaf like any other: you see its spine panel, and the rest of it appears when you unfold it.
Opened-out foldouts no longer show the edges of the book's pages in the middle of the sheet.
Pages are sharp when you zoom in: they now load at full size from Yale's photographs.
What's new: click the version number at the top left to see what changed, and when.
Unfolding and folding: the panels open one after another, like a map, and the book eases to its new size instead of jumping.
More room for the pages: zoom, the opening's tags and its note share one slim row under the pages, and the bar above stays on one line in narrower windows.
Zoom could not go below 100%. It now goes out to 30%, and stays zoomed out as you turn the pages. (Reported by a reader.)
Notes under the pages were cut off with no way to read the rest. Long notes now have a "more" link that shows the whole note. (Reported by a reader.)
The zoom buttons and their hint covered the bottom of the pages and the page labels.
The pages changed size from one opening to the next, when the bar above them wrapped or a note was longer.
f70r2 was cut off at the right, through the middle of its paragraph. It now shows the whole panel.

f70v2 (Pisces) was far wider than the other pages: its photograph shows the panel opened flat across an extra crease. The crease is now a fold, so folded, f70v2 is a page of normal width, and the flap opens with Unfold.
Links and Go to for 70v2 and 101v opened the following opening. They now open the one where the page shows.

First release: the book in 3D, the Reader with its foldouts, the Info pages on Lisa Fagin Davis's research, bookmarks, a crop tool for re-cutting pages from Yale's photographs, and your own orders of the sheets.
